$meta.title: Paper I / Collective-Exhaustion non-derivability — attempt taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the CE (collective exhaustion) non-derivability collection. Load first for the shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill in.
$meta.what_is_it: CE = collective exhaustion: that σ-additivity of a finitely-additive charge holds under Stone completion. The collection asks whether CE can be DERIVED from first-order coherence of the base Boolean algebra + its refinement system. Answer: no — CE is an irreducible commitment.
$meta.status: PARKED with fully-recorded kills. The CE non-derivability FACT survives (folklore: Łoś + Loeb 1975 + FHM 1990). Paper I's headline (novel beyond Kolmogorov) does NOT survive audit (σ-Loomis–Sikorski realization gap, Prop B2). Coherence/completion direction parked (Howson 2008 owns the core). The standalone companion note was retired (double kill: broken proof + folklore).
$meta.the_shape: Three layers. (1) The settled core: CE non-derivability fact + the irreducibility theorem (no structural condition implies CE; ultrafilter counterexample) + the four-faces vocabulary. (2) The kills: Paper I headline (σ-LS gap), companion note (folklore FHM 1990), Strategy D (Gaifman 1964 ZFC-stronger), Simpson conjecture (δ_U counterexample), CE-as-sheaf / CE-as-gluing (both = the σ-additivity tautology, no cohomological unification). (3) The open frontier: the ultralimit-representation ladder (rungs 1-3 RESOLVED positive, rung 4 was Strategy-D, now retired) + the philosophical reading (CE = volitional honesty about infinity, possibly Gödel-undecidable).

categories.settled_fact: an established result / vocabulary that survives
categories.kill: an attempt killed on prior-art, error, or triviality
categories.wall: the structural obstruction kills bottom out at
categories.ladder_rung: a rung of the ultralimit-representation investigation
categories.concept: a conceptual finding (often from the dated development log)

settled_core.name: CE non-derivability fact
settled_core.one_line: σ-additivity under Stone completion cannot be forced by first-order coherence on the base BA. Folklore (FHM 1990, Loeb 1975); verified via Łoś ultraproduct witness. Survives as Paper-I internal synthesis.

settled_core.name: CE irreducibility theorem
settled_core.one_line: No condition in the index structure (SUD, UD, refinement) or algebraic structure (normalization, compatibility, finite additivity) implies CE. Proof: an ultrafilter observer satisfies all structural conditions while failing CE (SUD+NCC ↛ CE; fcContent on ℚ).

settled_core.name: Four faces of CE (vocabulary)
settled_core.one_line: CE has four equivalent faces: measure-theoretic (σ-additivity), Yosida–Hewitt (pure-charge decomposition), Stone-support (μ̂ concentrates on pure points), model-theoretic (Łoś). Reusable vocabulary.

kills.name: Paper I headline (novel beyond Kolmogorov)
kills.one_line: Prop B2 'Support condition' asserts μ̂(pure(Ω))=1 but the σ-complete-ultrafilters-realized step is unproved = the σ-Loomis–Sikorski realization gap. THE VISE: under realization hypotheses B2 reproduces Kolmogorov (folklore); under the general regime B2 is false. No regime both correct AND novel.

kills.name: Companion note (countable additivity not first-order axiomatizable)
kills.one_line: DOUBLE KILL — withdrawn ultraproduct-of-Diracs proof has a fatal ℵ₁-saturation defect; the corrected ultrapower proof is SOUND but the result is FOLKLORE (FHM 1990, Loeb 1975). Retired to memory only.

kills.name: Strategy D (measure-free non-σ-complete atomless BA)
kills.one_line: Gaifman 1964 (PJM 14:61) already exhibits an atomless BA with no strictly-positive FINITELY-additive measure — STRONGER, in ZFC. Never field-open; the 'empty cell' was an artifact of the literature recording these algebras only in completed form.

kills.name: Simpson sublocale conjecture
kills.one_line: δ_U (Dirac at a free ultrafilter, purely f.a.) gives a one-point spatial measure-1 sublocale, refuting the conjecture; classically the non-spatiality Simpson studies (constructive) vanishes. CE is irreducibly about the Boolean (clopen) sublattice.

kills.name: CE as sheaf condition
kills.one_line: Dictionary translation, not a theorem. The finite/countable boundary is invisible to a finitary Grothendieck topology; the countable-partition topology that sees it just restates the σ-additivity definition.

kills.name: CE as cohomological gluing obstruction
kills.one_line: Zafiris localization: σ-completeness is an axiom not forced by the sheaf condition; states stay finitely-additive throughout; no cohomology computed. Biesel 2024: σ-additive ↔ sheaf only for countable covers (the tautology). No unification with Abramsky–Brandenburger.

walls.name: σ-Loomis–Sikorski realization gap
walls.one_line: σ-complete ultrafilters need not be realized as points — the standing wall that sinks Paper I's Prop B2 and that the companion note also hit. The same realization gap recurs across the programme (cf. σ-essential rem:dw).

ladder_rungs.name: Rung 1 — ultrafilter-generated {0,1}-charges
ladder_rungs.one_line: RESOLVED positive: pointwise ultralimit of Dirac charges represents. The base case.

ladder_rungs.name: Rung 2 — finite-cofinite algebra
ladder_rungs.one_line: RESOLVED positive: pfa(E) one-dimensional; ℓ_fc = limit of (1/k)Σδ_n.

ladder_rungs.name: Rung 3 — atomic / non-atomic / minimal-join
ladder_rungs.one_line: RESOLVED positive across 3a (atomic, density of principal UFs), 3b (interval algebra Lebesgue), 3c (P(ℕ)/fin, σ-additivity reduces to finite, vacuous).

ladder_rungs.name: Rung 4 — non-σ-complete non-atomic intermediate join
ladder_rungs.one_line: Canonical decomposition theorem (B≅(B↾A)×(B↾A^c); gap ⟹ measure-free factor) + subalgebra embedding lemma. The OPEN case reduced to Strategy D — now RETIRED (Gaifman 1964). So the ladder's frontier is closed by prior-art.

concepts.name: Consistency/Coherence Punnett square
concepts.one_line: 2×2: Consistent+Coherent (classical probability), Consistent+Incoherent (Łoś / CE failure), Inconsistent+Coherent (Gleason / quantum), Inconsistent+Incoherent (Kochen–Specker). Axes = distributivity vs state-extension/σ-additivity. Organizes, does not predict (intuition pump, demoted from theorem target).

concepts.name: Howson 2008 placement
concepts.one_line: Howson (2008, BJPS) 'De Finetti, Countable Additivity...' owns the core: consistency has compactness (finitary), σ-additivity doesn't = 'missing completeness theorem'. This prior-art is why the coherence/completion paper is parked.

concepts.name: Locale-theoretic CE characterization (Layers 1-3)
concepts.one_line: Layer 1 (shallow +): CE restatable on complemented frame-elements (clopens) — restates, doesn't derive. Layer 2 (deep −): CE/non-CE indistinguishable on general opens (compactness forces τ-additivity both ways). Layer 3: Simpson conjecture DEAD. ∴ CE is not frame-internal classically beyond the Layer-1 tautology.

concepts.name: OML center-obstruction mechanism
concepts.one_line: Tentative: admissibility for a non-Boolean OML = CE applied to its CENTER. Pták 1987 'exotic logics' give σ-orthocomplete OMLs with f.a. but no σ-add states (center C(L)≅BA with no σ-add probability). Gleason exceptionality: L(H) is a factor (trivial center) so geometry forces σ-additivity, bypassing the center obstruction.

open_questions.name: CE as volitional commitment (Gödel-undecidable?)
open_questions.one_line: Philosophical reading (LIVE): the finite/countable gap is a COMMITMENT gap, not structural — CE = a finite observer's volitional honesty about an infinity it cannot reach. Suspicion: CE-justification is formally undecidable (any formal condition is satisfiable by an ultrafilter failing CE).

open_questions.name: Ultralimit-representation paper (staged targets)
open_questions.one_line: Proposed paper: σ-algebra obstruction (Nikodym) + finite-cofinite (done) + multidimensional pfa (done) + Stone/βℕ reformulation + measure-free Radon-free spaces (likely ZFC-independent). Methodology viable even though individual proofs aren't novel.
